summary.text: CDAO states that it leads DoD efforts to operationalize Responsible AI by creating policy, tools, and training, and it publicly released a Responsible AI Toolkit. CDAO announced contract awards to U.S. frontier AI companies and described providing access to generative AI models and platforms across DoD components. CDAO describes Open DAGIR as a competitive acquisition approach for procuring and integrating industry technology, and says its realignment to USD(R&E) is intended to accelerate Department-wide AI transformation.
